mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (measured as the 3-month change in FEDFUNDS) signals an easing monetary policy that reduces risk-free rates and boosts equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where FEDFUNDS has declined over the last 3 months are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A CPIAUCSL reading above 205.0 (current as of t-2mo) signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to tighten monetary policy, which reduces equity valuations and produces negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL > 205.0, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both housing starts (HOUST) and industrial production (INDPRO) are above their respective 12-month moving averages, it indicates a synchronized expansion in the real economy, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where both HOUST and INDPRO are above their 12-month moving averages are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods of high unemployment (UNRATE > 5.0%), the economy is in a recessionary phase, leading to reduced corporate earnings and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE > 5.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A positive change in the quarterly GDP (GDPC1) from the previous quarter signals improving economic conditions, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where GDPC1 has increased from the previous quarter are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) signals strong manufacturing activity, which supports corporate earnings growth and produces positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: The 20-day forward returns in periods where INDPRO has increased from the previous month are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A UNRATE below 4.0% signals a tight labor market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 5d returns in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 4.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When both residential sales (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) are above their respective 12-month moving averages, it indicates a synchronized expansion in the housing market, which supports consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: The 60-day forward returns in periods where both RSAFS and HOUST are above their 12-month moving averages are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.
